description: A quartz crystal that vibrates 16 million times a second. Wired to a microcontroller's XTAL1/XTAL2 pins (each leg also through a 22 pF capacitor to GND) it gives the chip an exact clock.
how_to_use: Legs to chip pins 9 and 10 (either way round); a 22 pF capacitor from each leg to GND.

plain.what: The chip's clock — a tiny quartz crystal that ticks 16 million times a second.
plain.how: It works either way round. Its two legs go to the chip's crystal pins (9 and 10).
